name: free5gc-compose
description: Official Docker Compose deployment for free5GC with pre-built images, UERANSIM integration, and monitoring support. The recommended way to run free5GC in containers.

docker_support.docker_evidence: This repository is a docker compose version of free5GC for stage 3. Prerequisites: Docker Engine, Docker Compose v2. Services include AMF, AUSF, CHF, N3IWF, NEF, NRF, NSSF, PCF, SMF, UDM, UDR, UPF, WebUI, UERANSIM, MongoDB.

eval_notes: Easiest way to spin up a full free5GC core. Actively maintained (v4.2.1 as of March 2026). Includes UERANSIM for end-to-end testing without hardware. Complete containerized 5G core for agentic evals. 20+ services provide realistic multi-NF environment for configuration, troubleshooting, and orchestration tasks. Turnkey 5G SA environment with integrated RAN simulation. Quick setup for testing 5G core procedures. UERANSIM integration provides realistic UE/gNB behavior. Good starter for 5G evals.
